_doc: Monster camps (scripts/match/camps.gd, docs/decisions/0048-camps-and-xp.md). kind_size: a map camp spot's layout kind -> its size. sizes, smallest first (the hot zone and a comeback are the next one up): name (player text), n monsters, big (the one big monster: the region's version of it), armor (the bundle's armor), orb (chance 0..1 of a perk orb, source 'camp'), gear (if set: one gear piece, this many rarity steps over the region's), big_rar (rarity steps over its roll for the big one). small: the small kinds when a camp has no region table. A camp's XP is the sum of its monsters (content/rules/xp.json). back_s: a cleared camp comes back once, this long after its clear (s), if no Hunter is within back_clear_r (m) and the spot is safe for back_safe_s (s); none after back_until_s (match s). max_mobs: camp monsters alive at once. spread (m): how far monsters stand from the camp's centre. bots (scripts/match/bot_camps.gd): ring_great: a region with this many Great Camps is the Crown, with 1 a mid region, with none a rim region; ping: the camp size a bot leader pings in each ring; crown_pick: chance a leader tries the Crown (at most one bot squad per match); camp_until_s: bots stop camping at this match time (s); safe_s: a camp is worth walking to while the spot is safe this long (s); blight_r: they leave when the Blight is this near (m); fight_r: a camp is skipped while a squad with a higher total level is within this of it (m); detour_r (m) and detour_below: after camp_until_s a squad whose best level is under detour_below walks to a returning camp within detour_r.
